name: The Path of the Protector
label: Quest
description: The Path of the Protector: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You honor my kind, friend. Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight.
You have earned another enhancement. Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, friend. May you never stray from the path of the protector!
